title: CPF Module Schema: SQL Managed Instance Service Pattern
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvcpat-mssqlmanagedinstance'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

admin_email.description: (Optional) The email of the Azure AD User or Group to be added as administrator of this PostgreSQL Server.

admin_object_id.description: (Optional) The object ID of the Azure AD User or Group to be added as administrator of this PostgreSQL Server.

administrator_login.description: (Required) The administrator login name for the new server. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

auto_rotation_enabled.description: (Optional) When enabled, the SQL Managed Instance will continuously check the key vault for any new versions of the key being used as the TDE protector. If a new version of the key is detected, the TDE protector on the SQL Managed Instance will be automatically rotated to the latest key version within 60 minutes.

azuread_authentication_only.description: (Optional) Specify if you want to enable only Entra ID authentication.

cmk_key_name.description: (optional) Key name to be used (max 127 chars)

collation.description: (Optional) Specifies how the SQL Managed Instance will be collated. Changing this forces a new resource to be created

containers.type: object({ metadata = optional(map(any), null) context = optional(string, null) instance = optional(string, null) })
containers.description: (Optional) Storage Container configuartions to be used for SQL MI Vulnerability Assessment.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

create_private_dns_zone.description: (Optional) Whether to create a private DNS zone for the SQL MI private endpoint. Defaults to true.

create_role_assignment.description: (Optional) Whether to create a role assignment to the service identity to allow access to the key vault keys.

database_format.description: (Optional) Specifies the internal format of the SQL Managed Instance databases specific to the SQL engine version. Possible values are `AlwaysUpToDate` and `SQLServer2022`. Defaults to `SQLServer2022`. Note: Changing from `AlwaysUpToDate` to `SQLServer2022` forces a new resource to be created.

deploy_sqlmi_pe.description: (Optional) Whether to deploy a private endpoint for sql managed instance.

deploy_sqlmi_pe_failover.description: (Optional) Whether to deploy a private endpoint for sql managed failover instance.

enable_entra_id_authentication.description: (Optional) Specify if you want to enable Entra ID authentication.

enable_user_assigned_identity.description: (Optional) Whether to enable user assigned identity for the SQL Managed Instance. Defaults to false.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

failover_enabled.description: (Optional). Set if the Failover should be enabled for the Managed Instance.

failover_storage_account_type.description: (Required) Specifies the storage account type in secondary region used to store backups for this database. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Possible values are GRS, LRS and ZRS.

failover_zone_redundant_enabled.description: (Required) Specifies whether or not the SQL Managed Instance is zone redundant in secondary region. Defaults to `false`.

firewall_private_ip_address.description: (Required). Private IP of the firewall located in the region where the Primary instance will be deployed.

firewall_private_ip_address_failover.description: (Optional). SPrivate IP of the firewall located in the region where the failover instance will be deployed.

general_purpose_v2_enabled.description: (Optional) Specifies whether the SQL Managed Instance should use the Next-gen General Purpose service tier. Defaults to false. Can only be set to true when using a General Purpose (GP_*) SKU.

hybrid_secondary_usage.description: (Optional) Specifies the hybrid secondary usage for disaster recovery of the SQL Managed Instance. Possible values are `Active` and `Passive`. Defaults to `Active`.

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block supports the following: object({ type = "(Required) Specifies the type of Managed Service Identity that should be configured on this SQL Managed Instance." identity_ids = "(Optional) A list of User Assigned Managed Identity IDs to be assigned to this SQL Managed Instance. Required if used together with customer_managed_key block." })

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

instancepe.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

key_size.description: (Optional) Specifies the Size of the RSA key to create in bytes. Allowed values are 1024, 2048, 3072 or 4096.

key_type.description: (Optional) Specifies the Key Type to use for the Key Vault Key.

key_vault_config.type: object({ context = optional(string, null) context_failover = optional(string, null) instance = optional(string, null) instance_failover = optional(string, null) deploy_kv_and_pe = optional(bool, true) deploy_kv_and_pe_failover = optional(bool, true) key_vault_id = optional(string, null) key_vault_id_failover = optional(string, null) enabled_for_deployment = optional(bool, false) enabled_for_disk_encryption = optional(bool, true) enabled_for_template_deployment = optional(bool, false) soft_delete_retention_days = optional(number, 30) kv_admin_role_app_spn_object_id = optional(string, null) public_network_access_enabled = optional(bool, false) sku_name = optional(string, "premium") network_acls = optional(object({ bypass = optional(string, "None") default_action = optional(string, "Deny") ip_rules = optional(list(string), []) virtual_network_subnet_ids = optional(list(string), []) }), {}) private_endpoint = optional(object({ is_manual_connection = optional(bool, false) static_ip_required = optional(bool, false) private_connection_resource_alias = optional(string, null) kv_ip_configuration = optional(map(object({ private_ip_address = string subresource_name = optional(string, "vault") member_name = optional(string, "default") })), {}) }), { is_manual_connection = false static_ip_required = false private_connection_resource_alias = null } ) })
key_vault_config.description: Object with cofigration for the Keyvault. As defined below context = context to be used for KeyVaults being deployed resources. context_failover = context to be used for KeyVaults being deployed resources in secondary region. instance = instance to be used for KeyVaults being deployed resources. instance_failover = instance to be used for KeyVaults being deployed resources in secondary region. deploy_kv_and_pe = (Optional). Boolean to deploy KeyVault and Private Endpoint for KeyVault. Default is true. deploy_kv_and_pe_failover = (Optional). Boolean to deploy KeyVault and Private Endpoint for KeyVault in secondary region. Default is true. key_vault_id = (Optional). KeyVault ID to be used for Private Endpoint for KeyVault. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. key_vault_id_failover = (Optional). KeyVault ID to be used for Private Endpoint for KeyVault in secondary region. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. enabled_for_deployment = (Optional). Boolean to enable KeyVault for deployment. Default is false. enabled_for_disk_encryption = (Optional). Boolean to enable KeyVault for disk encryption. Default is true. enabled_for_template_deployment = (Optional). Boolean to enable KeyVault for template deployment. Default is false. soft_delete_retention_days = (Optional) The number of days that items should be retained for once soft-deleted. sku_name = (Optional). Sku name for KeyVault. Default is premium. kv_admin_role_app_spn_object_id = (Optional). Object ID for the SPN to add KeyVault administrator role. public_network_access_enabled = (Optional). Specifies whether public network access is enabled for the Key Vault network_acls = (Optional). Object with network ACLs for KeyVault. As defined below { bypass = (Optional). Specifies whether traffic is bypassed for Azure services. Default is None. Possible values are None, AzureServices, Logging, Metrics, or AzureServices,Logging,Metrics. default_action = (Optional). Specifies the default action of allow or deny when no other rules match. Default is Deny. Possible values are Allow and Deny. ip_rules = (Optional). List of IP addresses or CIDR ranges to whitelist. Only IPV4 addresses are allowed. This list must not include IP address ranges within Azure services. This list can include IP addresses ranges from on-premises ranges. virtual_network_subnet_ids = (Optional). List of virtual network subnet ids to whitelist. This list must not include IP address ranges within Azure services. } private_endpoint = (Optional). Object with private endpoint configuration for KeyVault. As defined below { is_manual_connection = (Optional). Boolean to indicate if the connection is manual. Default is false. static_ip_required = (Optional). Boolean to indicate if static IP is required. Default is false. private_connection_resource_alias = (Optional). Resource alias of the private connection. Required if is_manual_connection is true. kv_ip_configuration = (Optional). Object with IP configuration for KeyVault. As defined below { private_ip_address = (Required). Private IP address of the IP configuration. subresource_name = (Optional). Subresource name of the IP configuration. Default is vault. member_name = (Optional). Member name of the IP configuration. Default is default. } }

key_vault_tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on Key Vault related resource.

license_type.description: (Required) Type of license the Managed Instance will use. Possible values are LicenseIncluded and BasePrice.

maintenance_configuration_name.description: (Optional) The name of the Public Maintenance Configuration window to apply to the SQL Managed Instance. Valid values include SQL_Default or an Azure Location in the format SQL_{Location}_MI_{Size}(for example SQL_EastUS_MI_1).

maintenance_configuration_name_failover.description: (Optional) The name of the Public Maintenance Configuration window to apply to the failover SQL Managed Instance. Valid values include SQL_Default or an Azure Location in the format SQL_{Location}_MI_{Size}(for example SQL_CentralUS_MI_2). If not specified, defaults to the value of maintenance_configuration_name.

mssqlmi_db_variables.type: map(object({ context = string instance = string name = optional(string, null) retention_days = optional(number, 7) retention_policy = optional(bool, true) long_term_retention_policies = optional(map(object({ weekly_retention = string monthly_retention = string yearly_retention = string week_of_year = number })), {}) }))
mssqlmi_db_variables.description: Defaults to `{}`. A map of sqlmi db to create. - `context` - (Optional) - Defaults to `null`. Context to be used for all service bus queues resources. - `instance` - (Optional) - Defaults to `null`. Instance tpo be used for all service bus queues resources. - `name` - (Optional) - Provide a custom name for the managed SQL database. If not set, a name will be generated. - `retention_days` - (Optional) - Specifies the short term retention policy - retention days for the new databases. - `retention_policy` - (Optional) - Should retention policy be applied or skip as per input. - `long_term_retention_policies` - (Optional) - Defaults to `{}`. Map containing long_term_retention_policy for this Managed Database. - `weekly_retention` - (Optional) - The weekly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 520 weeks. e.g. P1Y, P1M, P1W or P7D - `monthly_retention` - (Optional) - The monthly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 120 months. e.g. P1Y, P1M, P4W or P30D - `yearly_retention` - (Optional) - The yearly retention policy for an LTR backup in an ISO 8601 format. Valid value is between 1 to 10 years. e.g. P1Y, P12M, P52W or P365D. - `week_of_year` - (Optional) - The week of year to take the yearly backup. Value has to be between 1 and 52.

private_endpoint.description: - `private_endpoint` - (Optional) - Object with private endpoint configuration for SQL Managed Instance. As defined below - `is_manual_connection` - (Optional). Boolean to indicate if the connection is manual. Default is false. - `static_ip_required` - (Optional). Boolean to indicate if static IP is required. Default is false. - `private_connection_resource_alias` = (Optional) To create private connection resource alias - `ip_configuration` - (Optional). Object with IP configuration for KeyVault. As defined below - `private_ip_address` - (Required). Private IP address of the IP configuration. - `subresource_name` - (Optional). Subresource name of the IP configuration. Default is vault. - `member_name` - (Optional). Member name of the IP configuration. Default is default. - `soa_record` - (Required) An `soa_record` for the Private DNS Zone. Changing this forces a new resource to be created." - `email` - (Required) The email contact for the SOA record. - `expire_time` - (Optional) The expire time for the SOA record. Defaults to 2419200. - `minimum_ttl` - (Optional) The minimum Time To Live for the SOA record. By convention, it is used to determine the negative caching duration. Defaults to 300. - `refresh_time` - (Optional) The refresh time for the SOA record. Defaults to 3600. - `retry_time` - (Optional) The retry time for the SOA record. Defaults to 300. - `ttl` - (Optional) The Time To Live of the SOA Record in seconds. Defaults to 3600. - `private_dns_zone_vnet_links_registration_enabled` - (Optional) Is auto-registration of virtual machine records in the virtual network in the Private DNS zone enabled ? - `private_dns_a_record` - (Optional) An object for creating a record for the SQL MI private endpoint. - `ttl` - (Required) ttl for a record

proxy_override.description: (Optional) Specifies how the SQL Managed Instance will be accessed. Valid values include Default, Proxy, and Redirect.

read_write_endpoint_failover_policy.type: object({ mode = optional(string, "Automatic") grace_minutes = optional(number, null) })
read_write_endpoint_failover_policy.description: - `read_write_endpoint_failover_policy` - (Optional) - Object to define the read write endpoint policy for failover. - `mode` - (Required) - The failover mode. Possible values are Automatic or Manual. - `grace_minutes` - (Optional) - Applies only if mode is Automatic. The grace period in minutes before failover with data loss is attempted.

readonly_endpoint_failover_policy_enable.description: (Optional) Failover policy for the read-only endpoint. Defaults to true.

recurring_scans.type: object({ recurring_scans_enabled = bool recurring_scans_admins = bool recurring_scans_email = list(string) })
recurring_scans.description: - `recurring_scans` - (Optional) - The recurring scans settings. The recurring_scans block supports fields documented below. - `recurring_scans_enabled` - (Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if recurring scans is enabled or disabled. Defaults to false. - `recurring_scans_admins` - (Optional) Boolean flag which specifies if the schedule scan notification will be sent to the subscription administrators. Defaults to true. - `recurring_scans_email` - (Optional) Specifies an array of e-mail addresses to which the scan notification is sent.

resource_group_name.description: (Reqired). The name of the Shared Resources Resource Group. This Resource group usually contains the shared resources(non-routeable vnet).

resource_group_name_secondary_location.description: (Optional). The name of the Shared Resources Resource Group in the secondary region. This Resource group usually contains the shared resources(non-routeable vnet).

rotation_policy.type: object({ notify_before_expiry = string time_before_expiry = string time_after_creation = optional(string, null) expire_after = string })
rotation_policy.description: (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = "(Required) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." time_before_expiry = "(Required) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration." time_after_creation = "(Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration after create as an ISO 8601 duration." expire_after = "(Required) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration." })

rt_vnet_pe_subnet_id.description: (Optional). The ARM Resource Id of the subnet in Routeable Virtual Network in platform Resource group.

rt_vnet_pe_subnet_id_failover.description: (Optional). The ARM Resource Id of the subnet in Routeable Virtual Network in platform Resource group for failover instance.

secondary_location.description: (Optional) The secondary region for SQL MI failover..

secondary_type.description: (Optional) The type of the secondary Managed Instance. Possible values are Geo, Standby. Defaults to Geo.

storage_config.description: (Required). Object with cofigration for the Storage Account. As defined below context = context to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources. context_failover = context to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources in failover region. instance = instance to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources. instance_failover = instance to be used for Storage Account being deployed resources in failover region. deploy_sa_and_pe = (Optional). Boolean to deploy Storage Account and Private Endpoint for blob. Default is true. deploy_sa_and_pe_failover = (Optional). Boolean to deploy Storage Account and Private Endpoint for blob in failover region. Default is true. storage_account_name = (Optional). Storage Account name to be used by the pattern. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. storage_account_name_failover = (Optional). Storage Account name to be used by the pattern in failover region. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. storage_account_id = (Optional). Storage Account ID to be used by the pattern. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. storage_account_id_failover = (Optional). Storage Account ID to be used by the pattern in failover region. Required if deploy_kv_and_pe is false. account_tier = (Optional) Defines the Tier to use for this storage account. Valid options are Standard and Premium. account_replication_type = (Optional) Defines the type of replication to use for this storage account. Valid options are LRS, GRS, RAGRS, ZRS, GZRS and RAGZRS. account_replication_type_failover = (Optional) Defines the type of replication to use for this storage account in failover region. Valid options are LRS, GRS, RAGRS, ZRS, GZRS and RAGZRS. account_kind = (Optional) Defines the Kind of account. Valid options are BlobStorage, BlockBlobStorage, FileStorage, Storage and StorageV2. access_tier = (Optional) Defines the Access Tier for the Storage Account. • Possible values are: `Cool`, `Hot`. large_file_share_enabled = (Optional) Set to `true`, the Storage Account will be enabled for large file shares. nfsv3_enabled = (Optional) Set to `true`, the `NFSV3` protocol will be enabled. enable_key_access = (Optional) If set to `false` any requests to the account that are authorized with Shared Key, including shared access signatures (SAS), will be denied. retention_policy_days = (Optional) Specifies the number of days that the containers, blob, queues and share should be retained, the value must be between between 1 and 365. cmk_key_expiration_date = (Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z') for customer managed encryption key. kv_secret_expiration_date = (Required) Expiration UTC datetime (Y-m-d'T'H:M:S'Z') for Storage Account access key Key vault Secret. enable_file_share_AADDS_authentication = (Optional) Enable authentication to File Shares via Active Directory Domain Services`. restore_policy = "(Optional) The number of days for point in time restore. Must be less than the days specified in delete_retention_policy" https_traffic_only_enabled = "(Optional) to implement securtiy control, this property needs to be true to use techniques to establish an encrypted data channels over untrusted networks. However this needs to be false for file share because Azure Files doesn't currently support encryption-in-transit with the NFS protocol and relies instead on network-level security.." cross_tenant_replication_enabled = "(Optional) Specifies whether cross-tenant replication is enabled for the storage account." cmk_key_rotation_policy = (Optional) A rotation policy block as defined below object({ notify_before_expiry = (Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration. time_before_expiry = (Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration. time_after_creation = (Optional) Rotate automatically at a duration before expiry as an ISO 8601 duration. expire_after = (Optional) Expire a Key Vault Key after given duration as an ISO 8601 duration. }) encryption_scopes = (Optional) Map of the encryption scopes in the Storage Account.. As defined below object({ name = (Required). Name of the encryption scope. key_vault_key_id = (Required). Key Vault Id for encryption. }) rules = (Optional) A map of rule block as documented below: object({ name = "(Required) The name of the rule. Rule name is case-sensitive. It must be unique within a policy." enabled = "(Required) Boolean to specify whether the rule is enabled." filters = "(Required) The filters block supports the following: object({ blob_types = "(Required) An array of predefined values. Valid options are `blockBlob` and `appendBlob`." prefix_match = "(Optional) An array of strings for prefixes to be matched." match_blob_index_tag = "(Optional) A match_blob_index_tag block as defined below. The block defines the blob index tag based filtering for blob objects." object({ name = "(Required) The filter tag name used for tag based filtering for blob objects." operation = "(Optional) The comparison operator which is used for object comparison and filtering. Possible value is ==. Defaults to ==." value = "(Required) The filter tag value used for tag based filtering for blob objects." }) })" actions = "(Required) An actions block as documented below: object({ base_blob = (Optional) A base_blob block as documented below: object({ tier_to_cool_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = "(Optional) The age in days after last modification to tier blobs to cool storage. Supports blob currently at Hot tier. Must be between 0 and 99999." tier_to_cool_after_days_since_last_access_time_greater_than = "(Optional) The age in days after last access time to tier blobs to cool storage. Supports blob currently at Hot tier. Must be between 0 and 99999." tier_to_cool_after_days_since_creation_greater_than = "(Optional) The age in days after creation to cool storage. Supports blob currently at Hot tier. Must be between 0 and 99999." auto_tier_to_hot_from_cool_enabled = "(Optional) Whether a blob should automatically be tiered from cool back to hot if it's accessed again after being tiered to cool. Defaults to false." tier_to_archive_after_days_since_modification_greater_than = "(Optional) The age in days after last modification to tier blobs to archive storage. Supports blob currently at Hot or Cool tier. Must be between 0 and 99999." tier_to_archive_after_days_since_last_access_time_greater_than = "(Optional) The age in days after last access time to tier blobs to archive storage.
